narrative_engine.thesis: range balance regime (H4 stack down / D1 down · EMA spread -15.17 ATR (flat) · VWAP z 1.40σ oscillating) with no validated M1 pullback and no ±2σ M2 stretch — no edge is paying for the risk right now. Re-evaluate on the next footprint signal or a VWAP band touch.

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 35/100 — whales offering, ask-wall ceiling
